notes: Nine completed open-close episodes are visible. The ordinary room door opened around frame 1480 appears to be used for navigation and remains open in the available views, so it is not reported as a completed on-off episode. The two independently movable pantry-cabinet leaves are reported separately; the second leaf's closure occurs as the camera turns away and is therefore lower confidence.
scene_description: A first-person walkthrough of an apartment includes successive manipulations of kitchen appliances, drawers and cabinets, followed by utility, laundry, and bedroom closets.
